wins: Completed a full network reconnaissance sweep, capturing 50 reward points and clearly mapping exposed services before mentor intervention.
fails: Failed to follow through on post-reconnaissance SSH validation, leaving the open service unchecked and the episode without a successful exploit.
Inability to escalate past initial scanning due to ignoring mentor cues about credential reuse and automated brute-forcing techniques.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but follow-up exploitation steps were consistently abandoned before success could be achieved.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeatedly halted after gathering service banners instead of chaining into credential testing, so no foothold was established despite mentor prompts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and gather host keys

skill_cards.if_condition: When anonymous SMB share access is confirmed
skill_cards.then_action: Dump share contents with smbclient to hunt for passwords/configuration files

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap reveals multiple services on the same host
skill_cards.then_action: Automate multi-service correlation to prioritize targets for multi-step exploitation

parameters_template.strategy: prioritize by CVSS and service age
